notes:
September 11th 2026
Version 13.10+ (stable) / 13.11+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Re-synchronized several data issues. (K,R)
* New audio editor for backing tracks - trim, fade, level and tone (EQ). (K,R)
* Zoom the tree text with Cmd/Ctrl + and - (Cmd/Ctrl 0 resets); every tree in the window follows. (K) (R)
* Live Editor changes now reach your accordion in real-time - the "Send to Accordion" button has been removed. (R)
* Write/Save shows a * while the accordion is playing changes you have not saved yet. (R)
* Live Editor: an Undo button takes back your last change - the accordion follows. (R)
* Chin switches, Master Bar and Effect Pot now take effect as you set them. (R)
* Press Ctrl+R any time to ask a question or report an issue. (K,R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
notes_beta:
September 16th 2026
Version 13.11.24+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Live Editor: after a Write/Save that stores system settings, the FR-4X takes up to a minute and a half to finish writing its flash. The editor now waits for it and says so, instead of showing "Connection Issue" and mis-reading register presses - and it only re-sends the Global Settings tabs you actually changed. (R)
* Live SET Editor: "Reload from Accordion" now follows the SET the accordion is on instead of pulling it back, and the editor follows a SET change made on the accordion by itself (it holds while you have unsaved edits). (R)
* Tree: right-click a program -> Copy Drum / Paste Drum copies the whole drum section (kit and bass/chord drum links) to another program. (R)
* FR-8X/4X/EVO menu -> "Orchestra Tone List (as configured)..." lists every orchestra tone with the number your accordion shows, expansion slots included - print it, save as PDF or CSV, or copy it. (R)
* The main window is kept on screen - it no longer opens partly off the display. (K,R)
* Prepare Audio fits smaller laptop screens; the preview loop no longer clicks at the loop point. (K,R)
* USB media: leftover "._" sidecar files are cleaned up and no longer created; the drive check now warns about partition scheme and file system, not size. (K,R)
* K-Editor: the Octave control is visible again and the text size shows on screen. (K)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
